core_obligations: Construct the symmetric distinguishing test for all bounded-uniform comparison distributions.
Estimate the separation using the source-local Krawtchouk and truncation arguments.
difficulty_reason: Builds a symmetric test separating the constructed smoothed small-bias distribution from every bounded-uniform distribution and tracks the nearly optimal noise-dependent distance. The author explicitly distinguishes this conclusion from the threshold-tail theorem; neither is treated as a counted consequence of the other.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Five independent principal conclusions cover smoothed fooling, threshold-tail lower bound, distance-to-bounded-uniform lower bound, XOR fooling and general typical shifts. The author notes the two lower bounds are distinct and asks for a unifying result; they are not split parameter variants. Small-space/AC0 application corollaries and supporting claims are uncounted.
